projection: Allowlisted exact original command/status/settings fields and source byte hashes; not a new RPC execution or copied provider transcript.

commands.name: ca-add-dep
commands.description: Vet a new or changed third-party dependency for license, provenance, and supply-chain risk before any install runs.

commands.name: ca-adr
commands.description: Record user-decided ADRs or inspect their health read-only. Preserve attribution and acceptance evidence.

commands.name: ca-adr-status
commands.description: Inspect ADR health read-only; optionally select one ADR with --adr N.

commands.name: ca-audit
commands.description: Assemble the governance record for a range — commits, overrides, ADRs, sprint auto-decisions, open questions, checkpoint findings — into one dated audit packet. Read-only.

commands.name: ca-checkpoint
commands.description: Periodic multi-reviewer sweep of the whole codebase — surfaces a triaged checkpoint report.

commands.name: ca-chore
commands.description: Sanctioned lane for non-behavioral work — docs-only edits, dependency bumps, reverts. Type-scaled gates; no TDD demanded of prose.

commands.name: ca-cleanup
commands.description: Clean up an already-merged local branch after proving containment. Confirm each discard and preserve unique work.

commands.name: ca-commit
commands.description: Create a verified local Git commit when committing changes is requested. Not for explaining commit history, drafting a message only, or postponing a commit. Applies every commit gate and never implies a push or PR.

commands.name: ca-conflict
commands.description: Pause affected work and its actual dependents when rules conflict. Present both sources and the dependency scope; the user resolves. Continue independent authorized work.

commands.name: ca-context-check
commands.description: Inspect context drift and refresh selected source-backed documents under existing authorization.

commands.name: ca-create-context
commands.description: Build source-backed project context through bounded inspection, optional agents, and record-level knowledge writes.

commands.name: ca-debug
commands.description: Investigate an unexplained defect or unexpected behavior without changing application code. Use for root-cause diagnosis and an evidence-backed handoff, including a bounded unresolved result. Not for implementing a known fix, new features, or explanation-only questions.

commands.name: ca-decompose
commands.description: Develop greenfield intent or initialized brownfield target and delta in existing decomposition and knowledge records.

commands.name: ca-doctor
commands.description: Verify the active host install, package, command ownership, enforcement, wrapper self-test, and active-dispatch coverage gap. Read-only.

commands.name: ca-feature
commands.description: Build an authorized feature from a maintained specification, testable criteria and useful plan, without duplicating user approval.

commands.name: ca-fix
commands.description: Fix a confirmed bug: a failing regression test first, then a minimal fix, then the rest of the tdd gates.

commands.name: ca-init
commands.description: Opt this repo into codeArbiter — scaffold the root-level .codearbiter/ state store.

commands.name: ca-override
commands.description: Sanctioned, logged bypass of a gate or hard rule — one audit line, then proceed.

commands.name: ca-pr
commands.description: Open a PR or finish branch disposition; route CI watching and post-merge cleanup to their owners. Merge and discard need explicit authority.

commands.name: ca-prune
commands.description: Trim transcript clutter to extend session lifetime — analyze, prune a copy, or toggle the after-each-turn service. Dry-run by default; gains land at resume/compaction, not the current turn.

commands.name: ca-reconcile
commands.description: Inspect architectural variances with SMARTS; record only explicit user choices. Report-only requests make no changes.

commands.name: ca-refactor
commands.description: Restructure code without changing observable behavior: rename, extract, inline, move, deduplicate, or replace an internal implementation with an equivalent one. Prove parity through unchanged pre-existing tests. Not for new behavior, bug fixes, explanation-only questions, or committing finished work.

commands.name: ca-release
commands.description: Prepare a declared release target, or preview it with --dry-run. Derive its version and require authorization before publication.

commands.name: ca-review
commands.description: Review a diff with the reviewer fleet, funneled to one triaged verdict. Targets the current working diff, a path, or an inbound GitHub PR.

commands.name: ca-spike
commands.description: Exploratory spike on a throwaway branch — answer a named question with disposable code. Never merges; exits to a findings note or /ca-feature.

commands.name: ca-sprint
commands.description: Run an autonomous sprint from maintained specs and plans, with truthful verification and no duplicate artifact approval ceremonies.

commands.name: ca-standup
commands.description: Daily repo hygiene — review the day's repo state, then perform selected cleanups. Fast-forward only, never destructive without a yes.

commands.name: ca-status
commands.description: Show the project's current state at a glance — stage, open tasks, open questions, overrides since the last checkpoint, current branch. Read-only.

commands.name: ca-task
commands.description: Add, select, start, complete, or reopen local work through its owning store.

commands.name: ca-threat-model
commands.description: Threat-model a sensitive design with STRIDE on request. Read-only analysis of threats, controls, and implementation constraints.

commands.name: ca-tribunal
commands.description: Run an opt-in deep codebase audit with persisted findings. Confirm cost before dispatch; filing and telemetry need separate approval.

commands.name: ca-watch
commands.description: Watch a PR's CI to completion — diagnose on red, notify and offer the merge on green. Never auto-merges.

commands.name: llama
commands.description: Manage llama.cpp router models

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Manage MCP servers: sign in, reconnect, enable or disable, and change exposure
